answer: A farm cannot fake the aggregate without controlling every key it names, which means paying the island bond on all of them and exposing each to the relic slash. Attestations are aggregated into one signature over 9 distinct keys, and the aggregate must verify against each key's registered public value. Because the pulse audit verifies the aggregate, a single forged member invalidates the whole batch. Verification alone takes 4 days each. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
